configurePresets.name: debug
configurePresets.description: The Debug lane windows-ci.yml configures: Ninja, tests on, translations required, compile_commands.json exported for the clang-tidy gate. Requires VCPKG_ROOT (install-dependencies / scripts/install-deps.ps1) and a Qt prefix on CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH. DISH_REQUIRE_TRANSLATIONS is ON here, unlike CMakeLists' local-friendly OFF default, because local == CI is the point of the preset; a box without Qt Linguist fails configure exactly like CI would.

configurePresets.name: release
configurePresets.description: The Release lane windows-ci.yml, codeql.yml and release.yml configure: Ninja, tests off, translations required. The build preset pairs it with the Dish + dish_setup_image targets CI builds.
